faq.headline: Legal & Tax Questions Answered
faq.subheadline: Straight answers to the questions every foreign investor asks before committing.
faq.q1: How are new AL licenses currently being handled?
faq.a1: After the temporary moratorium in Lisbon and Porto's historic areas, the government revised AL rules under the "Mais Habitação" package. New licenses are now permitted in most municipalities outside designated containment zones. Our legal team verifies your property's eligibility and handles the full Câmara Municipal submission — typical processing time is 60–90 days.
faq.q2: Do I need a tax representative in Portugal?
faq.a2: Yes. Portuguese law requires all non-resident property owners to appoint a certified fiscal representative with a Portuguese NIF. Your representative receives official correspondence from the Autoridade Tributária, ensures timely IRS/CIRS declarations and quarterly filings, and acts as your legal point of contact. PortoPrime includes fiscal representation in our full-management package.
faq.q3: What is the actual tax rate on short-term rental income?
faq.a3: AL income is classified under Category B (independent professional activity). Under the simplified regime, 35% of your gross revenue is treated as taxable income, subject to a flat 25% withholding rate for non-residents. Under organized accounting, real deductible expenses reduce the tax base. PortoPrime models both regimes annually and switches you to whichever is more favorable.
faq.q4: Can my AL license be suspended or revoked?
faq.a4: Licenses can be suspended for repeated noise complaints, operating without valid liability insurance, or non-compliance with AIMA guest registration requirements. Our 24/7 management ensures you stay fully compliant: we file all AIMA check-in/check-out reports, maintain insurance records, and respond to every guest interaction — protecting your license at all times.
faq.q5: What does the management fee include — and how is it structured?
faq.a5: PortoPrime offers three transparent tiers: Essential (15%) — bookings, dynamic pricing, and multilingual guest communication; Standard (20%) — all Essential services plus cleaning, check-ins, minor maintenance, and monthly statements; Premium (25%) — all Standard services plus fiscal representation, AIMA & AL compliance, major maintenance, and an annual property inspection. No hidden charges — every item is detailed in your monthly dashboard.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How PortoPrime collects, uses, and protects your personal data under GDPR and Portuguese law.
privacy.intro: PortoPrime ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share information when you visit portoprime.pt or use our property-management services. We process personal data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR — Regulation 2016/679) and Portuguese Law 58/2019.
privacy.section1Body:
The data controller for personal data collected through this website and our services is PortoPrime, with registered office at Rua Fernando Farinha 25C, 1950-273 Marvila, Lisboa, Portugal.

For any privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact us at:
• Email: privacy@portoprime.pt
• Phone / WhatsApp: +351 915 481 058
privacy.section2Body:
We collect the following categories of personal data:

• Identification data — full name, email address, phone number
• Property information — location, type, condition, ownership status
• Communication content — messages you send through forms or WhatsApp
• Technical data — IP address, browser type, device, operating system
• Behavioural data — pages viewed, links clicked, time on site, referral source
• Marketing identifiers — Meta browser cookies (_fbp), click identifiers (fbc)

We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16.
privacy.section3Body:
We process your data for the following purposes, on the legal bases indicated:

• To respond to your enquiries and provide our services — performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
• To send you the Investment Guide PDF or other resources you requested — consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)
• To improve our website and services through analytics — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)
• To run targeted advertising on Meta platforms (Facebook, Instagram) — consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)
• To comply with our legal and tax obligations — legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR)
privacy.section4Body:
We use cookies and similar technologies to operate our website, remember your preferences (such as language), analyse traffic, and measure the performance of our advertising.

The types of cookies we use:

• Essential cookies — required for the site to function (e.g., locale preference). Always active.
• Analytics cookies — help us understand how visitors use the site.
• Marketing cookies — Meta Pixel cookies (_fbp, _fbc) used to measure and personalise advertising on Facebook and Instagram.

You can refuse non-essential cookies via the cookie banner shown on first visit, or change your browser settings at any time.
privacy.section5Body:
We share data with the following categories of recipients, only when strictly necessary:

• Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. — for advertising measurement and audience building. We send hashed contact details and pseudonymous identifiers via the Meta Pixel and the Conversions API. See Meta's privacy policy at https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
• Vercel Inc. — our hosting provider, which processes server logs and IP addresses on our behalf.
• Email service providers — for sending transactional emails (lead notifications, the Investment Guide).
• Portuguese tax and regulatory authorities — only when legally required (e.g., AL/AIMA reporting where applicable).

We do not sell your personal data to anyone.
privacy.section6Body: Some of our processors (Meta, Vercel) are based outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Where data is transferred outside the EEA, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or other adequacy mechanisms recognised under Articles 45–46 GDPR to ensure your data receives an essentially equivalent level of protection.
privacy.section7Body:
We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected:

• Lead-form submissions — up to 24 months from last contact, unless you become a client.
• Active client data — for the duration of the contract plus 10 years (Portuguese accounting / tax law).
• Marketing analytics — up to 13 months at Meta level (default Pixel data window).

After the retention period, data is deleted or anonymised.
privacy.section8Body:
Under the GDPR, you have the right to:

• Access the personal data we hold about you (Art. 15)
• Rectify inaccurate data (Art. 16)
• Erase your data ("right to be forgotten", Art. 17)
• Restrict processing (Art. 18)
• Object to processing based on legitimate interest, including direct marketing (Art. 21)
• Data portability (Art. 20)
• Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting prior processing (Art. 7(3))

To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@portoprime.pt. We will respond within 30 days.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese supervisory authority, the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD) — https://www.cnpd.pt
privacy.section9Body: We use industry-standard technical and organisational measures to protect your data: HTTPS encryption in transit, encrypted databases at rest, restricted access on a need-to-know basis, and regular security reviews. No system is 100% secure, but we work continuously to minimise risk.
privacy.section10Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top of the page indicates the current version. Material changes will be communicated via a notice on our website or by email to active clients.
privacy.section11Body:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, contact us:

PortoPrime
Rua Fernando Farinha 25C
1950-273 Marvila, Lisboa, Portugal
Email: privacy@portoprime.pt
Phone / WhatsApp: +351 915 481 058
